items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: suddenly had a hell of a band and he called his Kenton era Band. You wrote for that band?

ctx.x: He put together a band not unlike Boyd's band, as a matter of fact. It

wasn't nearly as good or adventurous, but in those days they were comparable. They were trying to do something extraordinary, and who else, Alvino Rey, who had always had kind of commercial perhaps, to say the least, suddenly had a hell of a band and he called his Kenton era Band. You wrote for that band?
